task.title: Add oxlint and rules to repository root
task.description: Install and configure oxlint at the repository root with a ruleset based on an existing ESLint configuration. Oxlint provides significantly faster linting than ESLint for JavaScript and TypeScript projects.
task.problem: The repository currently lacks a fast JavaScript/TypeScript linter. No oxlint configuration exists at the repo root, leaving code quality enforcement without rapid feedback.
task.value: Faster lint feedback than ESLint, consistent code quality enforcement across the project, and early detection of bugs and anti-patterns during development.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the repository has no oxlint configuration When oxlint is installed and configured at the repository root Then a configuration file exists at the repo root with appropriate rules
Given an existing ESLint configuration is provided When the oxlint ruleset is defined Then the rules are based on the provided ESLint configuration
Given oxlint is configured at the repository root When running oxlint from the repo root Then the project is linted successfully without configuration errors
